slides.title: Can a model learn useful steps for an unfamiliar task?
slides.notes:
Long-term aim: useful decomposition. This talk narrows to teaching useful next steps. Most crafting tests are flat tool policies.

We have a possible teaching-data paper, not a general recursive-reasoning result.

slides.title: A crafting game makes the outcome easy to check.
slides.notes:
Invented lantern example. Two sticks make a frame. Frame plus glowing stone makes a lantern.

Success requires the requested net increase in target items at finish. No partial credit. Selected TextCraft-Synth panels, not the full official benchmark.

slides.title: Show the relevant fact before the action.
slides.notes:
SFT teaches the next action from visible history. Repair reschedules lookups using a known solution. All 366 action labels stay fixed.

History and length change. Easier copying may contribute; mechanism is unresolved.

slides.title: The repair helped after retraining and on more goals.
slides.notes:
Each row: 8 goals x 2 worlds x 2 attempts. Sixteen distinct goals overall. Same labels and updates, not equal compute.

Original labels are quantity-corrected. Their fitted policy is weak. Longer training helps; discovery-based teaching is also strong.

slides.title: Let code write the known ingredient list.
slides.notes:
323/768 = 42.1%; 381/768 = 49.6%. Forty-eight goals across worlds and seeds, not 768 independent tasks. Same weights within pairs.

Code writes observed ingredients only. It neither creates materials nor selects the plan.

slides.title: What did we learn from reward training?
slides.notes:
Same diagnostic goals: 4, 4, 5, 4 of 16. The one extra success disappeared. Extra SFT1 is 4, not matched to RL3.

In MuSiQue sufficiency, warm/RL/extra SFT give 10/18/19 of 64. Reward training is not always better than more example training.

slides.title: Other datasets helped us ask what actually improved.
slides.notes:
MuSiQue: direct 54, SFT 53, RL 56 of 128; later RL54. Hotpot: 152 vs151 of256, 3.44x tokens.

Fresh news weakens RL-specific gains. MRCR exact24 to27, but retrieval29 to29. These scores measure different abilities.

slides.title: Can the teaching repair survive stronger tests?
slides.notes:
Proposed, not newly launched: new recipe structures, stronger teachers, more original training, another model and name controls.

Prior work already repairs/reschedules demonstrations. Ask what evidence would make this particular repair useful elsewhere.
